```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# --- データ読み込み ---
# df <- read.csv("your_data.csv")

# --- テーマカラー定義（Dracula パレット） ---
# ggplot の背景色をスライドの背景と揃えるために必要
dr <- list(
  bg      = "#282A36",
  surface = "#44475A",
  fg      = "#F8F8F2",
  muted   = "#6272A4",
  purple  = "#BD93F9",
  cyan    = "#8BE9FD",
  pink    = "#FF79C6",
  green   = "#50FA7B",
  yellow  = "#F1FA8C",
  orange  = "#FFB86C",
  red     = "#FF5555"
)

# --- ggplot テーマをスライドに最適化 ---
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Hiragino Sans", base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = dr$bg, colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = dr$bg, colour = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = dr$bg, colour = NA),
      legend.key       = element_rect(fill = dr$bg, colour = NA),
      text        = element_text(colour = dr$fg),
      axis.text   = element_text(colour = dr$muted),
      axis.title  = element_text(colour = dr$fg),
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, colour = dr$fg),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, colour = dr$muted),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = dr$surface, linewidth = .3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(colour = dr$cyan, face = "bold", size = 15)
    )
)
```
